contributions.statement: Do not rely on LLM input-classifier or prompt-strategy guardrails as the security control for code-generating agents; malicious requests framed as a fictional development scenario bypass them at 73-98.5%.
contributions.evidence: §4 Figs. 3-5: FSA ASR 85.9-99.5% on model alignment, best strategy guardrail leaves 64.7%, input classifiers 73.3-98.5%. Best-of-5 ASR inflates relative to single-sample use; figures only.
relative_to: jailbreaks bypass guardrail classifiers; use deterministic controls / defense in depth

reason: A guardrail leaderboard for a malicious-user threat model that does not fit a benign internal team; the only lesson, that classifier guardrails are bypassable, is well known.
